title: Ranker
html_source:
A soldier risen through the ranks to become an officer (Gifford, p72).

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: …come to a city gate, sentry there …“I wonder if he is quoting Kafka.

anchor.prefix: in front of the sun, steal a day's march on him. Keep it up for ever never grow a day older technically. Walk along a strand, strange land, come to a city gate, sentry there, old
anchor.suffix: too, old Tweedy's big moustaches, leaning on a long kind of a spear. Wander through awned streets. Turbaned faces going by. Dark caves of carpet shops, big man, Turko the terrible
